Caching is a proposed feature and differs from SQL tuning.
JWT is documented, but a specific middleware architecture is hypothetical rather than evidenced implementation detail.

remaining_quality_findings.finding: Comparing aggregated sales sums to source row counts is generally a units error; this criterion must not be used as a scoring reference.
UNIQUE(user,time_slot) permits different users to reserve the same exclusive slot. The constrained resource/time key must be established before prescribing a constraint.
IDs are retrieved and valid, but query-performance/observability source topics are weakly aligned with the generated concurrency/query-analysis questions.
Criteria should not prohibit genuine experience merely because it is absent from the CV. Meta-instructions about not claiming scaling/Kubernetes experience are unsuitable scoring checks.
Other criteria remain prescriptive or imprecise: seasonal patterns versus artifacts, reproducibility guarantees, leakage detection from distributions, and classifier monitoring terminology.
Some texts and anchors remain generic or weakly connected. The prompt goal of three explicit project details is not consistently achieved. Coverage is broad, not exhaustive.
Difficulty and semantic similarity are uncalibrated. Data Analyst/BGE q2/q3 are closely related (current cosine 0.85628; exact metrics are in runtime_summary.json); no human quality claim is made.
